title: agent.completions.response.Usage
description:
Aggregated token and cost usage for an agent completion.

This is the "primary" usage type that aggregates across all upstream
assistant responses within a single agent completion.

completion_tokens.description: Total tokens generated across all assistant responses.

completion_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of completion tokens (reasoning, audio, etc.) if available.

cost.description: Cost charged by ObjectiveAI for this request.

cost_details.description: Breakdown of upstream and upstream_upstream costs if available.

prompt_tokens.description: Total prompt tokens across all assistant responses.

prompt_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of prompt tokens (cached, audio, etc.) if available.

total_cost.description:
Total cost including upstream provider charges. Only differs from `cost`
when using BYOK (Bring Your Own Key).

total_tokens.description: Sum of completion and prompt tokens.

upstream_duration_ms.description:
Wall-clock milliseconds spent inside each upstream client,
summed across turns, fallbacks, and parallel agents.
